PURITY SQUAD OBERSOLDER (6)
CR 7

XP 3,200 each
Auttaine fighter 8
LN Medium humanoid (half-construct, human)
Init +6; Senses Perception +3

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 12, flat-footed 19 (+8 armor, +2 Dex, +1 natural armor)
hp 64 each (8d10+16)
Fort +7, Ref +4, Will +4 (+2 vs. fear); +2 bonus vs. disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, and effects that cause either exhaustion or fatigue.
Resist construct resistances

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk nine-ring broadsword +12/+7 (1d8+5/x3)
Ranged mwk musket +12 (1d12+2/x4)
Special Attacks weapon training (heavy blades +1)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 14, Con 13, Int 11, Wis 10, Cha 10
Base Atk +8; CMB +10; CMD 22
Feats Distracting Charge, Enforcer, Improved Initiative, Intimidating Prowess, Iron Will, Outflank, Weapon Focus (musket), Weapon Specialization (musket), Weapon Specialization (nine-ring broadsword)
Skills Heal +3, Intimidate +13, Perception +3, Survival +5
Languages Common
SQ armor training 2, half-plate, mwk musket, 12 bullets and black powder, mwk nine-ring broadsword
